options.content:
# Hermes Tool Usage

This dashboard is for the proposed shared collector scraped as **`hermes_tools`**. It displays bounded aggregate labels only: **profile**, **tool name**, **outcome**, **direction**, and **tokenizer**. Tool arguments, results, prompts, identifiers, filesystem paths, error text, and credentials must never be exported.

> **Estimated serialized payload tokens** approximate the size of tool request and response payloads (for example, `bytes_div_4`). They are **not** model-provider billing tokens and **not** downstream LLM token consumption.

panels.title: Tool calls by outcome (cumulative)
panels.description: Cumulative completed calls since the shared collector started. Displays the first call immediately; counters reset when the collector restarts.

panels.title: Mean tool-call duration
panels.description: Mean tool-call duration since the shared collector started. Displays after the first call; percentiles need multiple observations and are not used here.

targets.expr: sum by (tool_name) (hermes_tool_duration_seconds_sum{job="hermes_tools", profile=~"$profile", tool_name=~"$tool"}) / sum by (tool_name) (hermes_tool_duration_seconds_count{job="hermes_tools", profile=~"$profile", tool_name=~"$tool"})

panels.title: Serialized payload volume (cumulative)
panels.description: Cumulative serialized request/response payload bytes since the shared collector started. Payload content is never exported.

panels.title: Estimated serialized payload tokens (cumulative)
panels.description: Cumulative estimated serialized request/response payload tokens since the shared collector started. A size estimate, not billing or downstream LLM consumption.

targets.expr: sum by (tool_name, direction, tokenizer) (hermes_tool_payload_tokens_estimated_total{job="hermes_tools", profile=~"$profile", tool_name=~"$tool"})

title: Hermes Tool Usage
